heroTitle: Step-by-step AI, built for real small business.
heroSub: Not enterprise teams with a data department — you, your shop, and a weekend. Every playbook is plain-English and practical. Copy, paste, done.

startHere.title: New to AI? Do these four things first.
startHere.description: You don't need a strategy deck. You need a weekend and a coffee. Here's where every Prairie business should start.

steps.title: Make yourself findable by AI
steps.text: AI answer engines are the new front door. Make sure your business shows up when someone asks ChatGPT or Google's AI for a recommendation in your area.

steps.title: Kill one repetitive task
steps.text: Pick the most annoying, repeatable thing you do every week. There's almost certainly an AI or automation that handles 80% of it.

steps.title: Get consistent on social
steps.text: Consistency beats brilliance. Use AI to keep your feed alive without it becoming a second full-time job.

steps.title: Set your ground rules
steps.text: Decide what AI can and can't touch in your business — customer data, client work, anything sensitive — before your team runs ahead of you.

guides.title: Get cited by ChatGPT & AI search

guides.title: A month of social posts in one afternoon
guides.summary: The prompt-and-schedule workflow a Regina café uses to stay consistent — from idea to a fully queued month.

guides.title: Automate the 5 tasks eating your Mondays
guides.summary: Invoicing follow-ups, review requests, appointment reminders — the unglamorous wins that give you your week back.

guides.title: Write your AI ground rules in 30 minutes
guides.summary: A fill-in-the-blank policy for what AI can and can't touch — client data, customer info, and quality control.

guides.title: Turn one blog post into a week of content
guides.summary: Repurpose a single article into emails, social posts, and a short video script — without sounding like a robot.

guides.title: Claim your Sask + Canada AI grants
guides.summary: What kinds of funding a Prairie business can pursue for AI and tech adoption, and how to draft the application with AI's help.
